cases.title: the flow-level fields that matter at run time

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
summary: s
timeout: 30
value:
  same_worker: true
  skip_expr: flow_input.skip
  early_return: a
  cache_ttl: 60
  concurrent_limit: 2
  priority: 1
  preserve_step_tags: true
  flow_env: {B: 1, A: '$var:f/x/v'}
  modules:
    - id: a
      value: {type: identity}

cases.title: value.timeout, the flow's wall-clock limit, is kept as written, 0 or less included, which is unset when the flow runs (FX-52); the metadata timeout beside it stays apart

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
summary: s
timeout: 5
value:
  timeout: -1
  modules:
    - id: a
      value: {type: flow, path: f/x/sub}
files.f/x/sub.flow/flow.yaml:
summary: s
value:
  timeout: 30
  modules:
    - id: b
      value: {type: identity}

cases.title: the flow's identity and a step's job token scopes are decoded and dropped; a null value.timeout is absent

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
summary: s
on_behalf_of: u/someone
on_behalf_of_email: someone@example.invalid
value:
  timeout: null
  modules:
    - id: a
      job_token_scopes: ['oidc:write']
      value: {type: identity}

note: The flow fields of OF-16 that the engine reads, value.timeout included (FX-52); queue, placement and permission controls are dropped.
